title: Sleipnir Mobile for iPhone / iPad and Sleipnir Mobile for iPhone / iPad Black Edition provided by… (CVE-2026-116081)
description: Sleipnir Mobile for iPhone / iPad and its Black Edition by Fenrir Inc. have a vulnerability involving improper certificate verification. This flaw could allow a man-in-the-middle attacker to intercept encrypted communications. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.2. No specific affected versions or patches are currently identified.
